title: kate-ui: build the project tree from a file list
summary: tree.rs turns the flat relative paths of a project into a TreeNode tree: directories first, then files, each sorted without regard to case. A file node has no children. The project pane paints the tree in a later packet.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create tree.rs with the SPDX header and add mod tree; to lib.rs with the dead_code attribute used for files. tree_from_paths inserts each path component by component, creating directory nodes on the way; the last component is a file node. After insertion each children list is sorted: directories before files, then by name with to_lowercase. The root has path empty and is_dir true. The test tree_from_paths_sorts_directories_first uses [src/main.rs, README.md, src/lib.rs, docs/a.md] and asserts the root children are docs, src, README.md in that order and src holds lib.rs then main.rs. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: tree::tests::tree_from_paths_sorts_directories_first
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because tree.rs does not exist. After the change directories come first and names sort without regard to case.
